column3: NKJV has “the son of a Pharisee,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “a son of Pharisees.”
NKJV includes “let us not fight against God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with the unfinished question “if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?”
NKJV has “some of the Jews,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Jews.”
NKJV includes “tomorrow,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV includes “the Jews” as those plotting and the closing “Farewell,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks both.
